hero.title:
Don't push too hard
Neither do we.
hero.description:
Pretty chill.
Not very corporate.
Definitely making games.

Rynkar Games is an indie game studio fueled by curiosity, questionable ideas, and the occasional "this should probably work" moment.

We don't have a 20-page mission statement.
We don't call ourselves "industry disruptors."
We just enjoy making games that people can have fun with.

Some ideas become games.
Some become bugs.
Sometimes it's hard to tell which is which.

If you're here, welcome.
Grab a game, have fun, and if you find a bug... just pretend it's a feature for a little while.

about.title: Who We Are
about.description:
No need to overthink it. We're just making games that people can enjoy.
We like them too, which automatically makes us the best studio. (Source: us.)

games.title: Money Empire: Get Rich
games.description:
Money, gold, silver, cryptocurrency... 
Start with a little cash and build your own minting empire!
Print your own currency, hire new employees, and don't forget to maintain your 
brand-new printing machines!
